attempts.prompt: One transparent raster sprite, front-facing selection portrait of the entire visible facial membrane of the Monocle Man from the 2012 retail Silent Hill: Downpour Devil’s Pit train scene. Show the recognizable physical face with its heavy frowning mouth, flattened broad nose, shadowed eye on the viewer's left and the small circular metal monocle lit ivory on the viewer's right. The pale weathered ochre-gray membrane around this face stretches outward into seven irregular tapered anchoring sectors like the source. Follow the angular outer silhouette of the biological membrane closely. End each sector where pale stretched tissue naturally enters the short dark metal band visible on the reference. Include the short bands at the cutoffs and tiny embedded fasteners. The facial object ends there; external rails, hanging chains, mine wall and train are scene elements. Keep the thin diagonal chain on the face where it directly joins the monocle. Only the head is visible in the shipping game, so give a single complete view of this particular membrane, not a detached round skull, humanoid body, fleshy tentacles or tongue. Preserve the source's facial asymmetry and subtle strained folds. All attachment tips must be within the canvas with transparent breathing room on every side. Use restrained original-game lighting, high-resolution naturalistic material, modest glint from the lens. True alpha, no backdrop, halo, floor, UI, text or scenery. Single subject at highest native resolution.

attempts.prompt: One transparent archival game selection sprite for the sewer creature of the Underpass in the original Silent Hill 3 (2003). Depict the single complete, representative tentacle seen looping below the grating. Reference 1 is the recovered model gallery: use only the long S-shaped piece at its left as the main contour, both ends and all, not the other two sample views. Reference 2 is a submerged view showing its curled pale banded end and continuous dark mottling. Keep these original PS2 material colors, muted dirty beige, rusty brown and weak ivory interrupted by irregular dark crosswise streaks. A very long, narrow, rounded, limber organic appendage swoops from upper left toward the lower right and curls back near each end. One end is pale and blunt and the other thickens into a darker blunt turn. Follow the model closely including the original comparatively smooth, mottled material and softly faceted outline. The full visible article ends at the physical boundaries documented by the model. Only represent this single curving game appendage, with transparent breathing room around both end faces and the entire perimeter. Use modest neutral diffuse illumination, preserving how the pale bands against the rust surface read at card size. No extra appendages, body, head, mouth, teeth, suckers, eyes, spikes, fantasy redesign, particles, water, Heather, floor, text or layout. One continuous S silhouette on real alpha.
